item.title: Sparse Routing Improves Long-Context Retrieval in Language Models
item.description: arXiv:2607.11111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how sparse routing changes retrieval behaviour over long contexts. Our method improves recall at 128k tokens while reducing decode latency.
item.dc:creator: Mai Tran, Kenji Watanabe, Priya Raman

item.title: Cross-Modal Grounding for Embodied Agents
item.description: arXiv:2607.22222v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a grounding method that aligns visual observations with agent action plans.
item.dc:creator: Elena Sokolova, David Okoro
